candidate_universe.inventory_hash_algorithm: sha256 of UTF-8 ordinal path|size|file_sha256 rows joined by LF without a trailing LF
candidate_universe.declaration_hash_algorithm: sha256 of UTF-8 ordinal lowercase_logical_path|effect_name|selection_start_line|selection_start_column rows joined by LF without a trailing LF

executable_string_scan.policy: String presence is candidate evidence only and never proves a call path.

evidence_reviews.result: 473 Effect declarations (438 case-insensitive names) form the complete candidate universe for this corpus snapshot.
Located shader assignments are data_explicit evidence. Missing textual callers remain engine_or_unreferenced and were not promoted.
All 9 unique interface effectFile shader paths are covered by 13 versioned renderer-subtype contracts; those contracts prove only their listed Effects and are not EXE-hardcoded ABI entries.

80 ASCII and 3 UTF-16LE Effect-name string matches were recorded, but string presence is not a call path. No reviewed runtime trace, disassembly call-site proof, or official engine-entry contract was supplied for an individual Effect. The ABI catalog therefore remains empty.

excluded_evidence.reason: Absence of a data caller is not proof of an executable call.
A renderer selecting a file does not prove every Effect in that file and is modeled separately by renderer contracts.
A string occurrence without a reviewed call path or runtime observation cannot establish ABI reachability.

notes: Complete means the versioned candidate universe and available evidence classes were reviewed under the fail-closed policy. It does not claim that the executable has no hardcoded entries; newly obtained qualifying evidence must be reviewed and added to both this audit and abi-catalog.json.
